story.title:
Every building begins
on a desk.
story.text: A plan. A few lines. A promise to your buyers.

story.title: Then it rises.
story.text: We turn your CAD and Revit drawings into precise 3D models.

story.title:
We give it material,
light and life.
story.text: Stone, timber, glass and golden hour, rendered true to your specification.

story.title: Step inside.
story.text: Photoreal interiors, exteriors and walkthroughs that sell before the first brick.

projects.title: Ivory Residence Suite
projects.description: A layered master suite in ivory, travertine and smoked bronze, with a sculpted lounge, cove lighting and a statement chandelier.

projects.title: Residence 38/39
projects.description: A contemporary townhouse facade with cascading planters, exposed brick and a cantilevered balcony, rendered in natural daylight.

projects.title: Beans & Book Café
projects.description: A warm café-library with whitewashed brick, bentwood furniture and amber pendants, designed for an evening atmosphere.

projects.title: Bronze Suite
projects.description: A bedroom in warm bronze and greige with linear light, fluted panels and soft sculptural seating.

projects.title: Master Bedroom & Study
projects.description: Marble feature wall, oak joinery and arched niches, with a calm study corner.

projects.title: Heritage Church Garden
projects.description: A stone chapel set in a landscaped courtyard of flowering hedges, lamp posts and timber benches.

services.title: Interior Visualization
services.text: Residential, hospitality and retail interiors with accurate materials and lighting for approvals and marketing.

services.title: Exterior Visualization
services.text: Facades, towers, villas and masterplans in day, dusk and night versions for brochures, hoardings and launches.

services.title: Walkthrough Animation
services.text: Cinematic walkthroughs and flythroughs for sales galleries, social media and off-plan launches.

audiences.title: Developers & Builders
audiences.text: Sell off-plan with visuals that make buyers feel at home before ground-breaking.

audiences.title: Architectural Firms
audiences.text: A reliable visualization partner for competitions, client presentations and approvals.

process.title: Brief
process.text: Share drawings (CAD, Revit, SketchUp), references and finishes.

process.title: Clay & Camera
process.text: We model the space and agree camera angles before any material work.

process.title: Material & Light
process.text: Finishes, furniture, landscape and lighting, with revision rounds included.

process.title: Delivery
process.text: 4K/8K stills and animations, ready for print, web and screens.

about.title: A studio of one, obsessed with light.
about.text: I'm Adeeb, a 3D visualization artist working with builders, developers and architectural firms across India, the Gulf and Europe. I turn drawings into images that help projects get approved, funded and sold.
